amendment.subject: Registration amendment for {tournament} — payment instructions
amendment.queuedBody:
Hi {name},

we've updated your registration for {tournament}, which is waiting in the substitute queue:

{summary}

You owe nothing yet. Once a place frees up and the organizer admits you, we'll send payment instructions.

{tournament} team

surcharge.subject: Surcharge due — {tournament}

reinstated.subject: Reservation reinstated, payment received — {tournament}
reinstated.body:
Hi {name},

your payment of {total} (VS {vs}) arrived after your reservation had expired, but the place was still free — we've reinstated the reservation and accepted the payment. Your place at {tournament} is confirmed. See you at the tournament!

{tournament} team

afterExpiry.subject: Payment received after reservation expiry — {tournament}
afterExpiry.body:
Hi {name},

your payment (VS {vs}) arrived for your registration at {tournament}, but the reservation had already expired in the meantime. We haven't confirmed the place automatically — the organizer will follow up to sort out next steps.

{tournament} team

partial.subject: Partial payment received — {tournament}
partial.body:
Hi {name},

we've received a payment toward your registration for {tournament} (VS {vs}), but it doesn't yet cover the full amount. {outstanding} is still outstanding — once it arrives, your place will be confirmed.

{tournament} team

expiredHoldingPayment.subject: Reservation expired, payment held — {tournament}
expiredHoldingPayment.body:
Hi {name},

your reservation for {tournament} (VS {vs}) has expired without the full amount arriving. We are holding the partial payment you already sent — the organizer will be in contact about it.

{tournament} team

compositionReminder.subject: Roster reminder — {tournament}

confirmationNoPayment.subject: Registration for {tournament} — confirmed

amendmentNoPayment.subject: Registration amendment for {tournament}

promoted.subject: A place has opened — {tournament}
promoted.body:
Hi {name},

a place has opened for you in {discipline} at {tournament} — you are no longer a substitute.

{amount} is now due, by {due}.

Account: {account}
Variable symbol: {vs}

You can pay by scanning the attached QR code — it's made out for exactly this amount.

{tournament} team

promotedNoPayment.subject: A place has opened — {tournament}
promotedNoPayment.body:
Hi {name},

a place has opened for you in {discipline} at {tournament} — you are no longer a substitute.

Your registration comes to {total}. The amount is for your information — payment is settled by the organizer outside this system.

{tournament} team

substituteArrived.subject: You are taking a place — {tournament}

substituteArrivedSettled.subject: You are taking a place — {tournament}
substituteArrivedSettled.body:
Hi {name},

you are taking over {previous}'s place at {tournament}. The registration is unchanged, it is simply yours now:

{summary}

The registration is paid for; nothing is owed.

{tournament} team

substituteDeparted.subject: Someone else is taking your place — {tournament}
substituteDeparted.body:
Hi {name},

{substitute} is taking over your place at {tournament}. Your registration ends with that.

Any settling of the entry fee is between the two of you — Squire refunds nothing.

{tournament} team

demoted.subject: Moved to the substitute queue — {tournament}
demoted.credit: The {amount} you have already paid stays recorded against your registration and counts if the organizer promotes you.

paymentWhileQueued.subject: Payment received while you are queued — {tournament}
paymentWhileQueued.body:
Hi {name},

your payment (VS {vs}) arrived for your registration at {tournament}. Your registration is waiting entirely in the substitute queue and holds no place yet, so the payment has not been credited. The organizer will be in contact about what happens next.

{tournament} team

promotedPaid.subject: A place has opened — {tournament}
promotedPaid.body:
Hi {name},

a place has opened for you in {discipline} at {tournament} — you are no longer a substitute.

The place is already paid for, so there is nothing more to pay. Your participation is confirmed.

{tournament} team

confirmation.condition: Attending only with a place in all of: {disciplines}.
confirmation.conditionWaits: Still full: {disciplines} — so you wait in the queue for every discipline.
